invariants.rationale: The map loading process requires a valid file and tmxFile parameter is expected to represent the TMX file to load.
ImageResolver is necessary for associating images with tiles; assumed to be non-null for proper functionality.
If the parameter object is provided, its projectFilePath field or property is accessed for loading project file; null projectFilePath would likely lead to an error later.
Defends against cases when projectFilePath is present but empty; also is a syntactically valid string property assumption.
Map loading requires that the specified tmxFile exists on the filesystem or resource path.
